figures.finding: Morocco's Labour Code bars employing a minor, or admitting him to any undertaking or employer, before fifteen full years; the labour inspector may have any salaried minor under eighteen examined by a public-hospital doctor and send him away from work that exceeds his capacity.
figures.applies: Western Sahara, held to Morocco's rules by the owner's ruling of 28 October 2026 (register R-4446); no source was read saying the Code applies in the territory itself.

sources.said: Les mineurs ne peuvent étre employés ni étre admis dans les entreprises ou chez les employeurs avant l’4ge de quinze ans révolus.

figures.finding: Under Morocco's Labour Code no minor under eighteen may be employed as a salaried actor or performer in public shows by the undertakings listed by regulation without the labour inspector's prior written authorisation, given for each minor after consulting his guardian, and revocable at any time; publicity luring minors into the artist's profession for its earnings is forbidden; no minor under eighteen may be made to do perilous feats, acrobatics or contortion, and acrobats, circus and fairground showmen may not use minors under sixteen in their shows. The authorisation names actors and performers, not writers or directors.

value.follows: Morocco: Code du travail arts 145 to 148
value.permit: autorisation écrite préalable de l'agent chargé de l'inspection du travail, per minor, after consulting the guardian

sources.said: Aucun mineur de moins de 18 ans ne peut, sans autorisation écrite préalablement remise par l’agent chargé de l’inspection du travail pour chaque mineur et aprés consultation de son tuteur, étre employé 4 titre de salarié comme comédien ou interpréte dans les spectacles publics faits par les entreprises dont la liste … est fixée par voie réglementaire. L’agent chargé de l’inspection du travail peut procéder au retrait de l’autorisation précédemment délivrée

Il est interdit de lancer toute publicité abusive incitant les mineurs 4 s’adonner a la profession d’artiste et 4 en souligner le caractére lucratif. … Il est également interdit 4 toute personne pratiquant les professions d’acrobate, saltimbanque, montreur d’animaux, directeur de cirque ou d’ attractions foraines, d’employer dans ses représentations des mineurs 4gés de moins de 16 ans.

figures.finding: Majority is eighteen full Gregorian years under Morocco's Family Code (art. 209), the rule held to apply in Western Sahara; a child has discernment from twelve.

value.follows: Morocco: Code de la famille (Moudawana, 2004), art. 209

figures.applies: Western Sahara, held to Morocco's rules by the owner's ruling of 28 October 2026 (register R-4446); WLUML reports the Mudawana takes effect in the territory under Moroccan rule, but no official text was read saying so. The Family Code's own PDF was unreachable (503), so the article is read from Yale's reproduction.

figures.finding: Under Morocco's law, held to apply in Western Sahara, a minor's engagement as a salaried actor or performer binds only with the labour inspector's prior written authorisation for that minor, given after consulting the guardian; a discerning minor's other acts are valid if wholly to their profit, void if harmful, and otherwise need the legal representative's approval. No set-aside of earnings was found.

value.follows: Morocco: Code du travail art. 145; Code de la famille art. 225
value.binding: labour inspector's written authorisation per minor after consulting the guardian (performers); otherwise the legal representative's approval (art. 225)
